text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While you can downplay opinions as simply subjective, it's difficult to ignore the many forms in which they're expressed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Support, praise, envy, criticism… Some comments may be pleasant, but others can be hurtful…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While waiting for Kawakami Princess to show up at my office, I hurriedly check through her new fan letters before she arrives.
choice_data_list: …I'll hide these opinions in this box.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess ran in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup just a few days ago, so I made today's training a little lighter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff…
choice_data_list: It looks like you're still a bit fatigued.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: N-no, not at all! I'm ready for you to bring on the heat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite what she says, her body is stiff and constricted. She's not running with the same ease she's shown before.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: There you are, Trainer! And Kawakami Princess, long time no see!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You're…

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess, I already talked to your trainer about this, but I'd like you to do a live appearance on my program.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Is that so?
choice_data_list: As long as you want to, of course.
As long as you want to, of course.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: Now that the Tiara tour is over, I'm hoping you'd be willing to deliver a message to our viewers in your own words! Please consider it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: In my own words…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll do it! Thank you for the opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Kawakami Princess and I arrive at the venue for the live broadcast.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Trainer! Could you come over here for a second?

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: As I mentioned the other day, we've prepared a surprise cake to celebrate Kawakami Princess's efforts in the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: We'll start off by giving her the gift, and then she can talk about her future ambitions, okay?
choice_data_list: I'm sure she'll be thrilled.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: We made the cake her favorite flavor, too. I'm glad I asked you beforehand. Haha, this is so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, the live broadcast begins.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone! Welcome to another episode of Meet the Racers! This week, we're broadcasting live! ♪

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Our guest today is an Umamusume who's been on quite a roll recently! It's Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …It's a pleasure to be here.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: What's that? Are we a bit nervous? Hehe… well, we've got just the antidote for that!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: In today's program, we've arranged a surprise present for you, Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A surprise present?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This must be it… The surprise present Trainer was hiding from me before.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Hehe, isn't the cake just lovely?! It's topped with all of your favorite fruits, too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —sorry. I'm… I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm not elegant, and I'm not princess-like… I lack the dignity required for a race like the Queen Elizabeth II Cup…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So please… please forgive me for all my disrespectful behavior!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Um… Kawakami Princess?
choice_data_list: Sorry—could we stop for a moment?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess's shoulders tremble as tears well in her eyes. I take her to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for making such a scene…
choice_data_list: …What's wrong?
…What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I saw them—all those letters.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "You crushed my favorite racer's chances in the Japanese Oaks. Her one and only big chance."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "I can't believe that at the Shuka Sho—the grand finale of the Tiara tour—all you could talk about was yourself. Not a single word of praise for your opponents."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Everything you say, everything you do, it's always about yourself. You're the worst princess there is."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "You aren't fit to enter a dignified and historic race like the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. You never were."
choice_data_list: …None of that is true.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You can be honest with me. I mean, I… I…

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, this is a press conference for racers entering the Japanese Oaks. Don't you think you should behave more appropriately?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: After all, a princess blows past all the foes who stand in her way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I intend to win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, like a true princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A princess is full of spunk and bravery, but blessed with the dignity and grace to show mercy to her enemies. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A princess is strong and shows sincere respect for her opponents. I thought I'd learned that from Princess Fighter, and yet…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I tried to paint myself as the only star. I treated the other racers not as rivals, but as foes that needed to be defeated.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I was arrogant and looked down on the other Umamusume. I was incredibly self-centered!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I hurt the feelings of others without even realizing it… Everything is all my fault!
choice_data_list: You did nothing wrong.
You did nothing wrong.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's not true. It can't be true. Because I… I…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm not a princess at all! That's why no one thinks I am! I'm just… I'm just an embarrassment!
choice_data_list: Don't say that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her big eyes well up with tears. It looks like she could break down at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She keeps putting all of the blame on herself, but is she really the only one who should shoulder that burden?
choice_data_list: You're wrong. It's my responsibility for not giving you proper guidance.
You're wrong. It's my responsibility for not giving you proper guidance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm her trainer. And that means it's my role to lead her in the right direction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I'll hide these opinions in this box.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I should never have hidden those opinions from her. I should have explained them honestly, and taught her what lessons she could take from them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My job is to lead her along the path to becoming a wonderful Umamusume who feels no shame when she looks back on her past.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But I'm the one who actually did all those things…
choice_data_list: Even if that's true, you're not the only one to blame.
Even if that's true, you're not the only one to blame.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: B-but…
choice_data_list: I'm sorry for making you shoulder all that alone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer… It's not your… It's my…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My…
choice_data_list: …Let's keep growing together.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Sob…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! I'm sorryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess loudly bawls her eyes out. Once the tears have ceased, we make a pledge to keep improving together.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you're okay? The live broadcast isn't over yet, but…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm truly sorry for before. I'd like to say some final words, if that would be okay.
choice_data_list: Allow me to join her too, please.
Allow me to join her too, please.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text: All right. Just don't push yourself if you don't feel up to it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Of course.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: To bring this episode to a close, Kawakami Princess has some final words she'd like to share with all the viewers out there.
choice_data_list: We're very sorry for what happened back there.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I apologize for suddenly losing my composure and giving everyone such a shock. I must have made the staff worry terribly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But I swear that from this moment forth, I will conduct myself properly as a princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …So I'd like you all to continue watching me.
choice_data_list: Thank you for your support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Facing the program's viewers head-on, Kawakami Princess expresses her newfound determination with utmost sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, I learn that this episode received around seventy viewer complaints. I contact the TV producer to apologize, but he tells me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Don't worry about a thing. I'm still a fan of Kawakami Princess, and so is everyone else here."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the Kinko Sho. I'll do my best to support her so she can enter the race as a proud princess.
